mostWorthwhile.text: Creating the extraction well was most worthwhile: the heated probe and cloudy trickle made the source of the water clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the line to the processor felt predictable, though it completed the water route.

surprise.text: I was interested that the probe warmed the ice to produce water, and that the processor then removed both grit and dissolved contaminants.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each followed the water from the ice to the tap, although each decision had only one combination available.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical details of extracting and treating water made me curious about the next challenge.
